title: Bicarbonate–hemoglobin coupling adds no established airflow-ratio prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Adding a bicarbonate×hemoglobin term to flexible standard predictors did not establish improved prebronchodilator FEV1/FVC prediction in NHANES: source n=3504, target n=3900; target MSE gain -2.00641509e-07, joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap95%CI [-1.23278837e-05, 7.43747236e-06]. This registered frozen-model transfer test compares independently sampled2007–2008 and2009–2010 cross-sections, not two splits. Target cycles were previously used for other questions, so this is not wholly untouched confirmation or independent clinical-program validation. Small improvements and harms are compatible with the interval; no mechanistic null or equivalence is established. AI-authored; author self-checked, not independently peer reviewed.
